topic: teardown of a fictional roofing site: headline, chat pop-up, long form
hook: This roofing site loses you 3 storm calls before anyone books.
caption:
Comment WEBSITE and I'll mark up your roofing site the same way, free.

Tallowbrook is a made-up roofer in Wichita. Real problems though.

The headline talks about family values and never says roof repair. The chat pop-up lands right on the phone number. And the quote form wants 11 answers from someone holding a bucket under a leak in April.

3 small fixes. Same site, way more calls.

#roofing #roofer #roofingbusiness
